title: Implement the non-executing V4 Project Model detector
goal: Inspect raw project XML without target execution and aggregate structured Architecture Conformance findings and coverage through the V4 Host.
acceptanceCriteria: Validated module configuration is passed explicitly from the selected profile to the adapter.
Project/package references, target frameworks and graph completeness are inspected without invoking target build logic.
Layered findings and non-vacuity coverage are preserved by Host aggregation.
Missing projects and zero-match evidence return structured prerequisite outcomes.
The synthetic profile exercises Architecture Conformance in Pre while P0-P4A remain green.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged with no active workflow or remote change.
